grades.quote: According to the different states in `FCSR` , this floating-point format conversion operation follows the operation in IEEE 7542008 standard as shown in the following table.
grades.reason: Shows that the LoongArch FRINT.{S/D} conversion instruction has no rounding field of its own. It takes the rounding mode from FCSR.RM and the inexact-exception enable from FCSR.Enables.I. The table maps each mode and enable state to an IEEE 754-2008 function.

grades.quote: `MOVGR2FCSR` modifies the value of the software writable field corresponding to the floating-point control and status register indicated by fcsr according to the value of the lower 32 bits of the general register `rj` .
grades.reason: Describes how MOVGR2FCSR writes the software-writable FCSR fields, which is the mechanism for changing the global state. It never mentions the rounding mode field or conversion instructions, so it gives only auxiliary information.
